subject: math
description: Choose suitable units for measuring volume and capacity, including cubic units and liquid units for everyday objects and containers.
learningObjectives: Select cubic units for solid space and liquid units for containers
Match common objects and containers to suitable measurement units
Explain why a chosen unit is reasonable for a situation
Avoid confusing area units, volume units, and capacity units
prerequisites: Recognize length units such as centimeter and meter
Understand that area measures flat surface and uses square units
Recognize common containers such as cups, bottles, tanks, and boxes
Read simple unit labels such as cm, mL, L, cm³, and m³
